column1: # Reikun eval gold set — one row per query cluster (not one row per
# alternative — a single query is exactly one row).
#   expected_answers — every accepted alternative for that query, joined by
#     " / ", ordered most-to-least preferred (top-ranked answer listed first).
#   notes — optional; explains a nuance, disambiguates near-synonyms, or
#     flags why a listed alternative counts as acceptable.
#   en_words        common English nouns/adjectives   -> Japanese headword
#   en_verbs        "to X" English verb phrases        -> dictionary-form verb
#   en_descriptive  descriptive/paraphrased English    -> target Japanese word
#   ja_words        Japanese kanji-form words           -> exact self-match
#                     (+ unabbreviated form where one commonly exists)

column3: 美しい / 綺麗 / 素敵
column4: 美しい = aesthetic/elegant; 綺麗 = pretty/clean; 素敵 = lovely/nice
雨傘 is the explicit rain-umbrella form, less common as a default translation
覚える = to memorize/retain; 思い出す = to recall something specific
入る = to enter, 来る = to come; 着く is the literal "arrive" but rare as a learner answer
手伝う = assist with a task; 助ける = rescue/save or help more broadly
開ける is transitive; 開く can be transitive or intransitive
住む = reside; 生きる = live/be alive — both valid; 有る's "to live" is a minor sense
止まる is intransitive (something stops); 止める is transitive (you stop something)
始まる is intransitive; 始める is transitive

column3: 求める / 望む / 欲する
column4: verb forms of "want"; 欲しい is the い-adjective headword, not a true verb
尋ねる = ask (a question, someone); 問う = inquire; 頼む/誘う/聞く also valid but excluded
